stamp: recorded via MCP, client reported as
label: Model notes, recorded via MCP; not evidence.

states.current: current: made on the latest revision, about the claim this report makes
states.stale: stale: made on an earlier revision, or about a claim that has changed since
states.orphaned: orphaned: what it was about is not in the latest report

reasons.verified: the file exists at a revision the report read and names a changed symbol in code, outside a comment or a string
reasons.no_config: no workspace configuration was given to reachmap mcp, so no file was read
reasons.unknown_repo: the repository is not in the workspace configuration, so no file was read
reasons.repo_not_read: the report did not read this repository at any revision, so there is no revision to read the file at
reasons.symbol_not_changed: the symbol is not the name of a symbol or a contract field that this change touched
reasons.symbol_qualifier: the symbol is qualified with a class or module other than the one the change touched
reasons.symbol_not_distinctive: the symbol is defined too often, or its definitions could not be counted, so it does not link code by name
reasons.file_absent: the file is not in the tree at the revision the report read
reasons.file_unreadable: the file could not be read, so nothing is established about it
reasons.no_reader: this kind of file is not read as code by this version
reasons.unparsed: the file could not be read as code
reasons.not_in_code: the symbol does not appear in the code of the file (a comment or a string does not count)
reasons.unchecked_text: a proposed file given as plain note text was not checked; propose_file checks one

intro: A note is what a model client wrote beside this report. It is not a finding, not evidence and not coverage, and it changes no area, priority, risk, confidence, count or gap. A verified proposed file is still a note: the check says the file exists at a revision the report read and names the symbol in code, not that the change reaches it.
groups: Made on the latest revision, about the claim this report makes.
Notes on an earlier revision or an older claim
Each shows the revision it was made on. A rerun makes a note stale; it is kept, not applied.
Notes about something no longer in the latest report
The area or finding these were about is gone. They are listed here and attached to nothing.
other: Notes with a state this version does not know
The state is shown as it was recorded.
